concerns.text: The plan sources the primary genome‑AST data from the HuggingFace dataset `ncbi/pathogen_detection` (see “Data Availability & Scope Adjustment” section). This dataset is **not listed in the verified‑datasets block**, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) which requires all external citations to be verified. Simply adding a checksum step does not satisfy the verification requirement.

All steps are claimed to run on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM, ≤ 6 h). Running `snippy` (full read‑mapping and variant calling) plus `mob_suite`, `isfinder`, and the downstream XGBoost training for up to 1 000 isolates is unlikely to complete within the 6‑hour, 7 GB RAM limit on a 2‑core CPU runner, making the compute plan infeasible under the platform constraints.
